title: 黑白大片
prompt: Use case: a real photograph from a luxury pet fashion studio shoot, the kind a premium pet-apparel brand prints in a fashion magazine. Image 1 is the identity reference only, not a pose or background template. Keep the same adult gray toy poodle from Image 1, with charcoal curly coat, lighter muzzle, floppy ears and compact build. One pet only, no people, no hands. Set, garment and moment: A black-and-white fashion magazine portrait in deep silver-gelatin tones on a charcoal seamless backdrop, a black bentwood cafe chair beside the dog. The poodle sits upright on the floor in a natural dog pose, chin lifted, eyes turned to the camera with a cool, composed look. It wears a real fitted black ribbed-knit dog turtleneck sweater made for dogs: the roll neck sits snugly around its neck, its front legs come through short knitted sleeves and the knit hugs its back and chest, with one slim silver chain collar over the roll neck. One hard side key light, crisp contrast, fine film grain. The garment is a real piece of pet clothing sewn for this animal's body shape, the kind actually sold for pets and put on a real dog or cat for a shoot: it wraps the animal's own back, chest and neck, the legs come out of it naturally, the fabric sits with believable weight, small folds and slight bunching where the body bends, and fur pokes out at the edges. The pet keeps its real animal anatomy, proportions and posture; it is clearly an animal wearing pet clothes, not a person. Photographic qualities: one dominant key light with natural falloff, true-to-life fur with individual strands, realistic eye moisture with one catchlight, believable contact shadow on the floor or seat. Medium-format camera, 85-100mm lens at about f/4, refined magazine colour grading, mild contrast, fine grain, no plastic retouching. Attitude: noble, poised and a little aloof, a calm self-assured gaze, so any owner would want this shot of their own pet. Indoor studio only. Framing: Three-quarter to full body: the pet sits or stands in its own natural animal posture at about 55-70% of frame height, so the pet-cut garment is clearly worn on an animal's body, with the set piece partly visible beside it. Avoid: anthropomorphic dressing, a human torso or human shoulders, an upright human-like posture, human dress shirts, shirt collars, neckties, suit lapels on a human-shaped chest, clothes that look painted or pasted onto the fur, a head pasted on a costume, cartoonish costumes, crowns, extra accessories, cluttered sets, outdoor scenery, glowing rim light, oversaturated colours, perfect symmetry, extra limbs, duplicate pets, CGI or illustration look, text, logos or watermark. Return one photograph only.
